 Home › Football news › Al Ahly FC release tickets for Saudi Pro League clash with Al Nassr in Jeddah Al Ahly FC release tickets for Saudi Pro League clash with Al Nassr in Jeddah
 14 Nov 2026, 20:17 UTC · Source: YSscores In 30 seconds Al Ahly FC released tickets for their postponed Saudi Pro League round 9 match with Al Nassr.
 The game is scheduled for next Friday at the Al-Inma Stadium in Jeddah.
 Al Ahly FC sit sixth on 21 points; Al Nassr are third on 28 points.
 Al Ahly FC have announced that tickets are on sale for their upcoming Saudi Pro League match against Al Nassr, a postponed fixture from the ninth round. The game is scheduled for next Friday at the Al-Inma Stadium in Jeddah.
 The club used its official account on the X platform to urge supporters to attend and back the team, describing the fixture as an important milestone in its league campaign.
